Final scoring restores the original mode and re-audits all eight affected archived controls, retaining their original missed-goal failures. No new physics or changed inputs.

limitations: The propagated ellipsoid is conditional on current localization covariance and the declared multiplier. It is not calibrated Gaussian confidence or a complete joint ego/object motion model.
Eight moving-body controls retain long-horizon cold-velocity coverage failures; all first observations and coverage denominators remain scored.

Eight disabled detour controls and four supported original missions retain missed-goal failures. All eight original missions remain unresolved, including the four without supported heading configuration.
The feature requires a motion envelope and absolute-heading fusion, remains disabled by default, and does not change continuous-frame acquired-proxy guarding.
Current pose uncertainty can change cached world radii without renewing scan/track acquisition times. No future process-covariance estimate or beyond-eight-second guarantee is added.

The conditions are authored, viewed, correlated simulation evidence. Measured automotive confidence, broader domains, real-time, real-vehicle, held-out, cross-platform and remote CI success remain unverified.
